async function snapshot(all=true){const d:Record<string,unknown>={};const tables=await h.observer`select tablename from pg_tables where schemaname='crm_private' order by tablename`;for(const {tablename:t} of tables){if(!all&&t.startsWith('b03_acceptance'))continue;d[t]=(await h.observer.unsafe(`select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by to_jsonb(x)::text),'[]') d from crm_private.${t} x`))[0]!.d;}return d;}
async function acl(){return {
 tables:await h.observer`select c.relname,c.relacl::text,c.relowner::regrole::text,c.relrowsecurity,c.relforcerowsecurity from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where n.nspname='crm_private' and c.relkind='r' and c.relname not like 'b03_acceptance%' order by c.relname`,
 functions:await h.observer`select p.oid,p.proacl::text,md5(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)) hash from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname in ('crm_api','crm_f1','crm_f2','crm_private') and p.proname not like 'acceptance_%' order by p.oid`,
 policies:await h.observer`select c.relname,p.polname,p.polroles::text,pg_get_expr(p.polqual,p.polrelid) q,pg_get_expr(p.polwithcheck,p.polrelid) w from pg_policy p join pg_class c on c.oid=p.polrelid where c.relname not like 'b03_acceptance%' order by c.relname,p.polname`,
 roles:await h.observer`select rolname,rolsuper,rolbypassrls,rolcreaterole,rolcreatedb from pg_roles order by rolname`
};}
async function state(f:F){return (await h.observer`select state from crm_private.b03_opportunities where opportunity_id=${f.opp.targetId}::uuid`)[0]!.state;}
async function negative(q:AcceptanceCommand,raw=false){const b=await snapshot();await assert.rejects(raw?rawApply(q):h.acceptance.apply(await h.auth(),write,q));assert.deepEqual(await snapshot(),b);}
async function rawApply(q:AcceptanceCommand,scope=h.scope,bad=false){const auth=await h.auth();return h.runtime.begin(async tx=>{
 const row=(await tx`select actor_id::text,admin_scope,access_generation::text,epoch_id::text from crm_api.f2_lookup(${auth.subject}::uuid,${auth.sessionId!}::uuid)`)[0]!,binding=await postgresF1Binding(tx),data=encodeF1Fields(['CRM-H2-ACCEPTANCE1',canonicalCommercial(q)]);
 const context=issueTrustedContext({identityId:'H2008 independent verifier',identityKind:'technical',purpose:'h1-evidence',scope,requestId:uid(),serverTime:now()}),t=createF1Issuer(h.f1)(context,binding,'C03',data,{resource:'evidence',action:'write_evidence'}),a=createF2Issuer(h.f2)(auth,{actorId:row.actor_id,scope:row.admin_scope,sessionId:auth.sessionId!,accessGeneration:row.access_generation,epochId:row.epoch_id},binding,'evidence_write',data,write);
 return tx`select crm_api.acceptance_apply(${a.payload},${bad?Buffer.alloc(32):a.mac},${t.payload},${t.mac},${data}) r`;
});}
async function verified(won=true){const f=await acceptanceFixture(h),r=await f.register(f.mid),q=await f.verification(r,won);await h.acceptance.apply(await h.auth(),write,q);return {f,r,q};}
async function rectify(f:F,r:AcceptanceCommand){const at=now(),e=await f.proof(`acceptance:error:${r.acceptanceId}`,r.coverage,at),proof=await f.proof(`acceptance:reevaluate:${r.acceptanceId}:Necesidad definida`,r.coverage,at);return f.q({action:'rectify',acceptanceId:r.acceptanceId,coverage:r.coverage,at,evidenceId:e,humanReviewed:true,reevaluation:{destination:'Necesidad definida',evidenceId:proof,dependentEffects:['verification','commercial']}});}
before(async()=>{h=await isolatedAcceptance('crm_h2_008_hist',55481,true);const prior=await acceptanceFixture(h),oldCom=h.req('communication',{direction:'incoming',channel:'email',sender_ref:prior.accepterId,coverage:prior.content.scope,initial_fact:'received',proposal_version_ref:prior.versionId},prior.opp.targetId);await h.evidence.apply(await h.auth(),write,{...oldCom,occurredAt:now(),coverage:prior.content.scope});await h.tasks.apply(await h.auth(),write,{action:'receive',operationId:uid(),taskId:uid(),expectedRevision:0,identity:{causeKind:'review',causeId:uid(),contextKind:'opportunity',contextId:prior.opp.targetId,scopeRef:prior.content.scope,relatedKind:null,relatedId:null,effect:'review-only'},material:{title:'SYNTHETIC prior followup',deadline:{kind:'unknown',reason:'no actual deadline'},priority:{kind:'pending',reason:'no actual priority'},sourceRef:'synthetic',sourceVersion:'v1',triggerRef:'manual',triggerVersion:'SM-TA-01-v1'},reason:'synthetic previous fixture'});old=await snapshot(false);oldAcl=await acl();await h.migration.unsafe(await readFile(new URL(process.env.H2008_REPRO_SQL??`../../supabase/migrations/${acceptanceMigration}`,import.meta.url),'utf8'));upgraded=await snapshot(false);upgradedAcl=await acl();});
after(async()=>{await h?.close();});

test('R46 historical agreement not revoked by later expired evaluation',async()=>{const {f,r}=await verified();const q={action:'evaluate' as const,operationId:uid(),proposalId:f.proposalId,opportunityId:f.opp.targetId,versionId:f.versionId,...await f.revisions(),sourceRef:'later uncertainty',reason:'new uncertainty',coverage:f.mid,at:now(),evidenceId:await f.proof(`offer:uncertain:${f.versionId}`,f.mid,now())};await h.offer.apply(await h.auth(),write,q);assert.equal(await state(f),'Aceptada / Ganada');assert.equal((await h.observer`select count(*)::int n from crm_private.b03_acceptance_verifications where acceptance_id=${r.acceptanceId}::uuid`)[0]!.n,1);});
test('R47 prior material revalidation for exact expired act permits verification',async()=>{
 const f=await acceptanceFixture(h,true);await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,80));const base=await f.registration(),reviewEvidence:Record<string,string>={};for(const aspect of ['prices','availability','conditions','capacity'])reviewEvidence[aspect]=await f.proof(`offer:review:${f.versionId}:${base.acceptanceId}:accept:${aspect}`,base.coverage,base.at);
 await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,3));const at=now(),evidenceId=await f.proof(`acceptance:agree:${f.versionId}:${base.acceptanceId}:${f.accepterId}:phone`,base.coverage,at),reg={...base,at,evidenceId};
 const issuance=(await h.observer`select to_jsonb(i) d from crm_private.b03_offer_issuances i where version_id=${f.versionId}::uuid`)[0]!.d;
 await h.offer.apply(await h.auth(),write,{action:'revalidate',operationId:uid(),proposalId:f.proposalId,opportunityId:f.opp.targetId,versionId:f.versionId,...await f.revisions(),sourceRef:'record real prior review',reason:'review actually before exact acceptance act',coverage:reg.coverage,at,actId:reg.acceptanceId,actKind:'accept',reviewEvidence});
 await h.acceptance.apply(await h.auth(),write,{...reg,...await f.revisions()});await h.acceptance.apply(await h.auth(),write,await f.q({action:'verify',acceptanceId:reg.acceptanceId,coverage:reg.coverage,at,reviewEvidence,won:true}));assert.equal(await state(f),'Aceptada / Ganada');assert.deepEqual((await h.observer`select to_jsonb(i) d from crm_private.b03_offer_issuances i where version_id=${f.versionId}::uuid`)[0]!.d,issuance);
});
test('R48 every material review guard independently withdrawn',async()=>{const f=await acceptanceFixture(h),r=await f.register(),q=await f.verification(r);for(const aspect of ['prices','availability','conditions','capacity']){const e={...q.reviewEvidence};delete e[aspect];await negative({...q,reviewEvidence:e});}});
test('R49 exact received multichannel agreement; each Communication guard',async()=>{for(const channel of ['whatsapp','email','form','web']){const f=await acceptanceFixture(h),r=await f.registration(f.mid,channel),com=h.req('communication',{direction:'incoming',channel,sender_ref:f.accepterId,coverage:f.mid,initial_fact:'received',proposal_version_ref:f.versionId},f.opp.targetId);await h.evidence.apply(await h.auth(),write,{...com,coverage:f.mid,occurredAt:r.at});await h.acceptance.apply(await h.auth(),write,{...r,communicationId:com.targetId});await h.acceptance.apply(await h.auth(),write,await f.verification(r));assert.equal(await state(f),'Aceptada / Ganada');}
 for(const field of ['sender_ref','proposal_version_ref','coverage','channel','direction']){const f=await acceptanceFixture(h),r=await f.registration(f.mid,'whatsapp'),material={direction:'incoming',channel:'whatsapp',sender_ref:f.accepterId,coverage:f.mid,initial_fact:'received',proposal_version_ref:f.versionId};const wrong={...material,[field]:field==='direction'?'outgoing':field==='channel'?'email':uid(),...(field==='direction'?{initial_fact:'none',recipient_ref:f.accepterId}:{})},com=h.req('communication',wrong,f.opp.targetId);await h.evidence.apply(await h.auth(),write,{...com,coverage:wrong.coverage,occurredAt:r.at});await h.acceptance.apply(await h.auth(),write,{...r,communicationId:com.targetId});await negative(await f.verification(r));}
});

test('R54 historical migration source bytes and ACL preserved',async()=>{assert.deepEqual(upgradedAcl,oldAcl);const {execFileSync}=await import('node:child_process');const files=(await readdir(new URL('../../supabase/migrations/',import.meta.url))).filter(x=>x.endsWith('.sql')&&x!==acceptanceMigration);for(const file of files){const path=`supabase/migrations/${file}`,base=execFileSync('git',['show',`d333f140abf63b900b7e6ffbfdcfc4869575cca5:${path}`]);assert.deepEqual(await readFile(new URL(`../../${path}`,import.meta.url)),base);}});
test('R55 two authorized sessions concurrently verify same root',async()=>{const {H0005PostgresAdapter}=await import('../../src/infrastructure/postgres/h0-005-adapter.ts');const first=await verifyAuth({verify:async()=>({subject:h.subject,passwordVerified:true,mfaVerified:true})},uid()),session=(await new H0005PostgresAdapter(h.runtime,h.f1,h.f2).establish(first)).sessionId,second=await verifyAuth({verify:async()=>({subject:h.subject,sessionId:session,passwordVerified:true,mfaVerified:true})},uid());const f=await acceptanceFixture(h),r=await f.register(),q=await f.verification(r),out=await Promise.allSettled([h.acceptance.apply(await h.auth(),write,q),h.acceptance.apply(second,write,{...q,operationId:uid()})]);assert.equal(out.filter(x=>x.status==='fulfilled').length,1);assert.equal(await state(f),'Aceptada / Ganada');});
test('R56 actual H2-005 rejection cannot affect accepted A but B remains independent',async()=>{const {f,r}=await verified();for(const partId of [f.mid,f.other]){const at=now(),evidenceId=await f.proof(`offer:reject:${f.versionId}:${partId}:${f.accepterId}:desconocido`,partId,at),com=h.req('communication',{direction:'incoming',channel:'email',sender_ref:f.accepterId,coverage:partId,initial_fact:'received',proposal_version_ref:f.versionId},f.opp.targetId);await h.evidence.apply(await h.auth(),write,{...com,coverage:partId,occurredAt:at});const q={action:'reject' as const,operationId:uid(),proposalId:f.proposalId,opportunityId:f.opp.targetId,versionId:f.versionId,...await f.revisions(),sourceRef:'real synthetic rejection',reason:'separate alternative',coverage:partId,at,partKind:'modality' as const,partId,recipientId:f.accepterId,lossReason:'desconocido',communicationId:com.targetId,evidenceId,channel:'email'},b=await snapshot();if(partId===f.mid){await assert.rejects(h.offer.apply(await h.auth(),write,q));assert.deepEqual(await snapshot(),b);}else{await h.offer.apply(await h.auth(),write,q);assert.equal(await state(f),'Aceptada / Ganada');assert.equal((await h.observer`select count(*)::int n from crm_private.b03_acceptances where acceptance_id=${r.acceptanceId}::uuid`)[0]!.n,1);}}});
test('R57 later requested Ganada preserves the initial verification and same Acceptance',async()=>{const {f,r}=await verified(false),q=await f.verification(r,true);await h.acceptance.apply(await h.auth(),write,q);assert.equal(await state(f),'Aceptada / Ganada');assert.equal((await h.observer`select count(*)::int n from crm_private.b03_acceptances where acceptance_id=${r.acceptanceId}::uuid`)[0]!.n,1);assert.equal((await h.observer`select count(*)::int n from crm_private.b03_acceptance_verifications where acceptance_id=${r.acceptanceId}::uuid`)[0]!.n,2);});
